name: vMix
author: Control It Team
subtitle: Live Video Production Software
descriptionText: Trigger transitions, active inputs, overlays, titles, and audio mixing on vMix Live Production software via HTTP / TCP API.

setupFields.label: vMix PC IP Address
setupFields.helpText: Enter IP address of the Windows PC running vMix.

setupFields.label: Web API Port
setupFields.helpText: Default vMix Web API port is 8088 (or 8099 for TCP).

actions.title: vMix: Cut Transition
actions.subtitle: Instant switch to preview input
actions.descriptionText: Executes an immediate hard cut transition.

actions.title: vMix: Set Active Input
actions.subtitle: Set program camera/video
actions.descriptionText: Directly sets the active Program output to a specified input index.
